summary: Verified the new DM-Only / Public visibility toggle end-to-end for both backend and frontend. Created /app/backend/tests/test_private_entries.py covering list filter, detail 403 sealed marker, category filter, search filter, and stats divergence between anon and DM — all 4 pytest cases pass. Playwright run confirmed: DM-side Lock toggle on the admin row flips state with toast + DM Only pill, DM Only badge on detail page, EntryCard DM Only pill in DM's /lore grid, anon listing hides the sealed entry (lore was empty after sealing because The Sundering was the only lore item — correct behavior), anon detail URL renders the SealedEntry component with watchful-eye SVG, overline 'Sealed by the Lanternkeeper', headline 'This page is not yours to read', and a working RETURN-to-Codex link pointing to '/'. Admin editor drawer shows the 'DM Only (hide from players)' checkbox (data-testid='field-is-private') alongside 'Pin to top of list'. The Sundering was sealed during testing and reverted to is_private=false — confirmed via API.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1370 lines and over the recommended 700-line threshold — should be split into modules (auth, entries, magic, sessions, pcs, rules, seeding). Not blocking this feature.

Both togglePin and togglePrivate in Admin.jsx PUT the entire EntryOut object back to PUT /entries/{id}; since EntryIn uses extra='ignore' the id/slug/timestamps are dropped harmlessly, but it's a minor over-fetch pattern.
EntryDetail's category overline always shows the lowercase entry.category string ('lore' rather than 'Lore & History'). Pre-existing, not part of this change.
seed_data_creation: Sealed 'the-sundering' during the run (both pytest and Playwright); reverted to is_private=false on completion. Seed state is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All DM-Only visibility flows are working end-to-end. Backend regression suite for this feature lives at /app/backend/tests/test_private_entries.py and includes auto-cleanup. The Sundering lore entry is used as the test fixture and is always reverted to public after each test. SealedEntry component selectors: sealed-entry, sealed-overline, sealed-back-link. Admin row selectors: toggle-private-<slug>, dm-only-<slug>, edit-<slug>. Editor field: field-is-private. Detail badge: dm-only-badge. Card pill: card-dm-only-<slug>.
